source.name: Footy Headlines: Alverca 26-27 Home, Away and Third Kits Released
source.quote: FC Alverca and Nike have officially released the club's new home, away, and third kits for the 26-27 season under the campaign slogan 'Uma Nova Altitude'.
source.note: The article's photos of the new shirts (for example https://www.footyheadlines.com/static/img/post/2026/08/11/Bk3WvH3wXrqvIte/alverca-26-27-home-away-and-third-kits-released.jpg, the blue shirt the SAD calls the equipamento principal) show 'PLACARD.pt' across the front.
